desc: The Cinnamon Toast Crunch Cereal makes a delicious breakfast option that can be enjoyed by kids and adults alike. Made with whole grain wheat and rice, this cereal is certified kosher, making it suitable for those with special dietary needs. The bulk case of Cinnamon Toast Crunch Cereal containing 10 packs is a good buy for supermarkets, hypermarkets, and retail stores. Cinnamon Toast Crunch(R), 16.8 oz Same retail box as sold in stores. Perfect for smaller operations. Top seller. Offers real cinnamon and sugar in every bite. Crispy, Sweetened WHOLE WHEAT and RICE Cereal. Both kids and adults love Cinnamon Toast Crunch.
features:
Features

Crispy Whole Grain Squares:Made with whole grain wheat and rice for a satisfying crunch in every bite.
Coated with Signature “Cinnadust”:Each square is blasted with the perfect mix of real cinnamon and sugar for bold flavor.
16g Whole Grains Per Serving: Contributes to your daily whole grain intake for better nutrition.
Fortified with 12 Essential Vitamins & Minerals: Includes iron, calcium, vitamin D, B vitamins, and more to support everyday health.
No Artificial Flavors or Colors: Made with natural flavors and free from synthetic additives.
Kid-Friendly & Family-Favorite: Loved across generations for its fun flavor, crunchy texture, and cinnamon-sweet taste.
Large Box Size: Ideal for families or cereal lovers who go through boxes fast.

Benefits

Deliciously Sweet Start to the Day: The classic cinnamon-sugar flavor makes mornings more exciting for both kids and adults.
Supports a Balanced Diet: Combines great taste with essential nutrients and whole grains.
Versatile Use Beyond Breakfast: Enjoy with milk, as a dry snack, or as a fun ingredient in cereal bars, snack mixes, or dessert toppings.
ingredients: Whole Grain Wheat, Sugar, Rice Flour, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Fructose, Maltodextrin, Dextrose, Salt, Cinnamon, Trisodium Phosphate, Soy Lecithin, Caramel Color, Rosemary Extract. BHT Added to Preserve Freshness. Vitamins and Minerals: Calcium Carbonate, Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.
